text: 金十数据10月10日讯，10日，国家市场监督管理总局召开新闻发布会，会上介绍了市场监管总局近期就美团收购麦芽田股权案举行公开听证有关情况。这是我国经营者集中审查中的首次公开听证，听证会上参会各方充分表达观点，达到了预期效果。美团收购麦芽田股权案是我国平台领域首起未达国务院规定的申报标准、依法要求申报的经营者集中案件。据市场监管总局反垄断二司副司长谢方介绍，经审查，本集中对中国境内配送聚合平台服务市场可能具有排除、限制竞争效果，可能影响中小商户自主选择运力，排挤其他第三方运力商；同时，集中进一步强化美团在中国境内网络餐饮外卖平台、即时零售服务平台市场的市场
text_en: Jinshi Data, October 10 — On the 10th, the State Administration for Market Regulation held a press conference, at which it briefed on the recent public hearing regarding Meituan's acquisition of Maiyatian equity. This was China's first public hearing in a concentration of undertakings review, and all parties at the hearing fully expressed their views, achieving the expected results. The Meituan acquisition of Maiyatian equity case is China's first platform-sector concentration of undertakings that did not meet the filing thresholds stipulated by the State Council but was legally required to be filed. According to Xie Fang, Deputy Director of the Second Antimonopoly Bureau of the State Administration for Market Regulation, upon review, this concentration may have the effect of eliminating or restricting competition in China's domestic delivery aggregation platform services market, may affect small and medium-sized merchants' independent choice of delivery capacity, and may squeeze out other third-party capacity providers; at the same time, the concentration further strengthens Meituan's position in China's domestic online food delivery platform and instant retail service platform markets
